summary: The PR fixes a regression issue with minversion, but introduces a dependency on pkg_resources which may not be available in all environments.

issues.description: Behavioral regression risk: the change may break existing behavior if pkg_resources is not available.
Non-minimal change / scope creep: the change introduces a new dependency on pkg_resources, which may not be necessary for the fix.
Project convention mismatch: the change introduces a dependency on pkg_resources, which is not a standard library in Python.
Insufficient tests: the PR does not include additional tests to ensure the fix works in all environments.
